data.name: One Try Only!
data.detailed_description:
One Try Only! isn’t just another platformer.

It’s about facing the moment when you know you can’t mess up.

You get one shot.

Miss a jump, slip once…and it’s over.

The game locks forever.

No retries. No second chances.

Breathe. Take your time, and everything will be alright.
We’ve built a chill atmosphere to help you stay calm.

One try. That’s it.

FAQ

Q: Can I restart the game after losing?
A: No. Once you fall, the game locks forever.

Q: What if I uninstall and reinstall or delete the save?
A: It won’t matter. Your attempt is tied to your Steam account.

Q: Is there a practice mode?
A: No but there is a small playground at the start where you can warm up.

Q: How long does a run last?
A: It depends on your skill, but a full run usually takes around 45 minutes.

Q: What if a bug happens?

A: Just like in life, it’s unfair, you still lose. But don’t worry, the game is tested carefully and bugs are extremely rare.
